metadata.title: GeoAlgeria wilaya telephone area code provenance
metadata.description: Why each of the eleven wilayas Law 26-06 created (codes 59 to 69) carries the phone_code it carries. A value appears here only with an official citation naming where in the document it was read; a null carries a reason naming the official texts searched and what each one said. The codes wilayas 1 to 58 carry predate this ledger and are not restated by it.
metadata.rule: A code is taken from an official text only: the Journal Officiel, an ARPCE decision or published numbering plan, or an Algérie Télécom announcement. It is never derived from the wilaya it was split from, and never taken from an encyclopaedia, directory or press listing.

sources.name: ARPCE: Numbering. The ten-digit plan national de numérotation adopted 22 February 2008, format ZABPQMCDU, where ZA is the geographic zone; numbering resources are allocated by the Authority under article 13 of Law 18-04
sources.date_note: The Authority's numbering page carries no publication date of its own. The plan it describes was adopted on 22 February 2008.

sources.name: ARPT: Nouveau plan de numérotation téléphonique pour l'Algérie (PDF)
Algérie Télécom: Les Nouvelles numérotations, the operator's own notice archive for number changes
sources.date_note: The notice archive carries no publication date. Its entries are the operator's MSAN-era local number changes, each naming its own communes.

sources.name: Journal Officiel n° 25 (Law n° 26-06 of 4 April 2026), the text that creates wilayas 59 to 69
Journal Officiel n° 40 (Presidential decree n° 26-206 of 25 May 2026), the codes and seats of wilayas 59 to 69
Journal Officiel n° 52 (Executive decree n° 26-253 of 15 July 2026), the daira annex for the new wilayas

no-official-allocation.statement: No official text allocates a telephone area code to this wilaya. ARPCE allocates numbering resources under the ten-digit plan national de numérotation of 22 February 2008, whose geographic digits identify a numbering zone rather than a wilaya, and the Authority has published no allocation for the 2026 cohort. The three texts that create and organise these wilayas are silent on numbering. Algérie Télécom has announced no new area code for them. The code carried by the wilaya this one was split from is not evidence for it, and is deliberately not copied here.

searched.looked_for: a text on the plan national de numérotation or on wilaya area codes, and any numbering article in the three texts that create and organise wilayas 59 to 69

citations.article: Law n° 26-06 in full, including the wilaya table at p. 16
citations.finding: Creates the eleven wilayas and lists them. No article addresses telephone numbering.

citations.article: decree n° 26-206, art. 1, items 59 to 69, p. 5
citations.finding: Fixes the code and the seat of each of the eleven wilayas. No article addresses telephone numbering.
Fixes the dairas of the new wilayas. The French edition of this issue contains no occurrence of numérotation, indicatif or téléphone.

searched.looked_for: the published numbering plan, and any decision allocating area codes to the wilayas created in 2019 or in 2026

citations.article: the Numbering service page, National Numbering Plan section
citations.finding: Describes the ten-digit plan of 22 February 2008 and the ZABPQMCDU format whose ZA digits are a geographic zone. Publishes no wilaya-to-code table and addresses neither cohort of new wilayas. No decision allocating a code to a new wilaya is listed.

citations.article: the allocation table of leading digits
citations.finding: 01 is unallocated and 02, 03 and 04 go to Algérie Télécom; no per-wilaya assignment was read. Text extraction was partial because the PDF streams are compressed, so a zone table inside it is unread rather than ruled out.

searched.looked_for: an operator announcement of new area codes for the new wilayas

citations.article: the Nouvelles numérotations section, its full notice list
citations.finding: Every notice concerns local number changes in named communes after infrastructure upgrades. No notice announces an area code, and none names a wilaya of the 2026 cohort.

no-official-allocation.note: A silence is not a negative. This records what was searched on searched_on and what it said; each source's own retrieved date is when that document was read. An official allocation published later replaces the null with the cited value.

metadata.note: Wilayas 1 to 58 are out of this ledger's scope. Their phone_code values predate it and no official citation has been established for them yet; see ROADMAP.md.
